quest.title: A Visitor From Westward Realms: The Flavor of Freedom
quest.description: A certain person from Sumeru is currently discussing something with Sara...

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Why, hello there! Are you talking about stuff to eat?

response.speaker: Sara
response.text: Ah, we meet again, you two. Indeed, one might say that our conversation did concern food, but... *sigh*

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: What happened? Don't worry, you can tell us. Maybe we can even help!

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: #If it's about food, we'll definitely help! Isn't that right, {NICKNAME}?

response.speaker: Nazafarin
response.text: Ah, by Lesser Lord Kusanali, the two of you are as warm-hearted as ever!

response.speaker: Nazafarin
response.text: So this is the issue. After you rescued me previously, I returned to Sumeru and wrote a report about the condiment market in Liyue.

response.speaker: Nazafarin
response.text: Unexpectedly, I was approached by Lord Sangemah Bay, who expressed interest in purchasing the condiments that were the results of my research.

response.speaker: Nazafarin
response.text: This most charitable merchant even offered to support any further research on my part! Ah, such good fortune! I signed right away, if you must know...

response.speaker: Nazafarin
response.text: I then sent my dear friend Parvaneh a letter regarding this, and she gave me her full support.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: So you're here in Mondstadt to start research into condiments?

response.speaker: Nazafarin
response.text: That is precisely right, my good Paimon. In truth, I should've already begun this research, but...

response.speaker: Sara
response.text: Nazafarin wants to work with us by adding her secret condiments to our dishes and letting our customers try them.

response.speaker: Sara
response.text: However, we have restaurant standards that we must maintain, lest we face complaints from long-time customers, so we can't take her up on that offer.

response.speaker: Sara
response.text: *sigh* We've actually been having this chat for a while now, but we haven't been able to come up with any better ideas.

response.speaker: Sara
response.text: I've been thinking that perhaps we could ask Jean to help. I'm sure she could find the best solution to this problem!

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Seriously!? Jean's super busy all the time, you know! So, uh, could we not make her come down just for this? We'll help out!

response.speaker: Nazafarin
response.text: Aha, you see, what did I say? The two of you are Nazafarin's saviors, as always!

response.speaker: Nazafarin
response.text: Right, then, there's no time to lose. Please, take this pot with you.

response.speaker: Nazafarin
response.text: We shall do it as we did previously. We will make the condiments, add them to dishes, and invite your friends to try them!

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Hehe. That's right, we'll do it just like before. Paimon volunteers to be the first taste-tester, by the way!

choices.text: Eh, we'll do this for Paimon, I guess.

response.speaker: Nazafarin
response.text: Ah, by Lesser Lord Kusanali! Do you not recognize me anymore?

response.speaker: Nazafarin
response.text: Perhaps my presence is too weak, like a speck of dust that might be blown away by a gust at any time...

response.speaker: Nazafarin
response.text: But I, for my part, remember your great deed in helping me develop seasonings and inviting all and sundry to try them!

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Huh? Looks like Sara's talking to someone over there. Might they be discussing food?

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: C'mon, let's go over there! Paimon's not gonna miss out on some good grub, not for the world!
